newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA barley export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 217,600 MT resulted as major increases for Saudi Arabia (217,800 MT), Cyprus (50,000 MT), and Japan (20,000 MT) were partly offset by decreases of 72,500 MT for unknown destinations.
Exports of 70,800 MT were two and one-quarter times the previous week and two and four-fifths times the 4-week average. The destinations were Saudi Arabia (57,800 MT) and Mexico (13,000 MT).
